title: Larry David’s 1983 Script for ‘Prognosis: Negative’ Went Viral in the Spring. That Was Only Part of the Story
summary: In an exclusive excerpt from Blake J. Harris' biography 'Emperor of Nothing, the 'Curb' creator and his former manager, Marilyn Black, explain how a pre-'Seinfeld' David managed to earn top dollar for the script and attract potential directors Rob Reiner and Richard Dreyfuss — before it all fell apart.
